QUOTE: **Only one screen shows a search field:** `search.tsx` is the only caller with `hasSearch={true}`. The `hasSearch` flag is what makes `NavigationHeader` render its search bar.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that `app/screens/home/search/search.tsx` is the only caller passing `hasSearch={true}`, which is the only one that enables the search field.
